item.title: Watch: Children's room with Hezbollah symbols found during IDF raids in Lebanon
item.description: IDF troops operating near Al-Khiam uncover weapons inside a civilian home, Hezbollah symbols in a children's room, and a storage site for explosive drones.

item.title: Fallen soldiers' comrades take Part in demolition of terrorists' homes
item.description: IDF troops demolish the homes of two terrorists who killed soldiers at Judea Junction, with members of the fallen soldiers' battalion taking part.

item.title: Huckabee to Newsmax: Netanyahu’s lead could reshape Israel’s next government
item.description: US Ambassador Mike Huckabee told Newsmax that Netanyahu’s stronger-than-expected election showing has shifted the political picture, but the battle to form a government is only beginning.

item.title: Tel Aviv Stock Exchange CEO calls for unity government
item.description: Tel Aviv Stock Exchange CEO Ittai Ben-Zeev urges party leaders to form a broad government, warning that political deadlock threatens economic growth.

item.title: Trump risks losing leverage over Iran as midterms approach
item.description: President Donald Trump could emerge weakened from the upcoming US midterm elections, potentially limiting his ability to take significant action against Iran.

item.title: Ben-Gvir: If elections were manipulated using foreign funds new elections must be held
item.description:
National Security Minister and Otzma Yehudit chairman Itamar Ben Gvir addressed the allegations against a Knesset member, stating that if it emerges that foreign funds were used to bribe voters and manipulate election results, it would constitute "a shocking corruption scandal and a severe blow to democracy and the sovereignty of the State of Israel."
Ben Gvir demanded that, if the allegations are proven, the Knesset member be prosecuted and sentenced to actual imprisonment. He added that if it is established that the election results were manipulated through the use of these funds, steps should be taken to hold new elections as soon as possible. "We will not allow anyone to steal our elections. Anyone who sells elections for money belongs in prison, not in the Israeli Knesset," he declared.

item.title: Watch: 18 infiltrators arrested in southern Israel operation
item.description: Border Police use drone to locate suspects hiding in wooded hills near the Tarkumiya Crossing, directing IDF forces to apprehend them.

item.title: The scenario preoccupying United Torah Judaism
item.description: Eisenkot has already begun making overtures to United Torah Judaism. What are the chances that these preliminary contacts will develop into a significant political move, and what will Eisenkot have to offer in return?

item.title: Initial report of Israeli injured in attack in Jordan Valley
item.description:
Initial report of an Israeli resident being attacked by Palestinian rioters and anarchists near Jackson's farm, near the community of Gittit in the Jordan Valley.
MDA teams called to the scene are providing medical treatment to the injured man, whose condition is described as mild.

item.title: RFK Jr. defends Israel and Jews in blistering attack on Islamism
item.description: US health secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. praises Jewish contributions to humanity, hails Israel as a bastion of freedom and accuses Iran, Gulf states and the Muslim Brotherhood of fueling anti-Israel propaganda.

item.title: Netanyahu ally: Trump and Herzog to intervene in push for unity
item.description: Dimona Mayor Benny Biton says the prime minister wants a unity government and suggests that President Herzog and Trump intervene to broker an agreement with Eisenkot.

item.title: Ben Gvir warns Haredim: 'Don't make historic mistake of joining the left'
item.description: Otzma Yehudit chairman and National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir acknowledged that he had expected a better election result and warned the haredi parties against joining a left-wing government.

item.title: Shas against Deri: 'This is just a publicity stunt'
item.description: Tensions run high in Shas following its election collapse: 'Instead of taking responsibility, he is trying to revive the 2014 resignation stunt so they will beg him to stay.'

item.title: Report: Joint Arab List MK received hundreds of thousands of shekels in cash
item.description: According to an i24NEWS report, a Knesset member from the Joint List received hundreds of thousands of shekels in cash, raising suspicions of bribery and money laundering.

item.title: 15-year-old charged with vandalizing Afula synagogue in antisemitic attack
item.description: A 15-year-old allegedly broke into an Afula synagogue after a family dispute, threw holy books onto the floor, poured liquid over them, set toilet paper rolls on fire and stole a charity box.

item.title: 'Trying to provide ladders': Herzog's message to parties ahead of consultations
item.description: Ahead of consultations at the President's Residence, Herzog calls on party leaders to acknowledge the election results and work to prevent another election.

item.title: How much funding did each party receive from the state?
item.description: Election funding for the 26th Knesset totals NIS 300 million. Technical splits by five lists added NIS 12.8 million, with another NIS 24 million expected in ongoing funding over a full term.

item.title: Freed hostage furious after Feiglin was omitted from article
item.description: Former hostage Rom Braslavski criticized Channel 12 after a report omitted Moshe Feiglin, whose grandson was killed in Gaza, from a list of bereaved MKs.

item.title: Israeli Boxer Ahavat Hashem Gordon faces antisemitic incident in Thailand
item.description: Ahavat Hashem Gordon was subjected to antisemitic remarks while filming a video in Thailand. Following the incident, he shared a message with his followers: "It's not worth the risk."

item.title: 4 eastern Jerusalem minors arrested on suspicion of throwing firebombs at Jewish homes
item.description:
Jerusalem District police and Border Guard soldiers arrested four minors from the A-Tur neighborhood yesterday, on suspicion of throwing Molotov cocktails at Jewish homes in the eastern part of the city.
The suspects were recorded at the time of the act and were located following investigative actions. The court extended the detention of the four until Wednesday. The police investigation continues.

item.title: Breakthrough at Shaare Zedek: 4 pacemakers implanted in new technique for 1st time
item.description: Four patients underwent pacemaker implantation using a technique designed to improve electrical coordination between the heart's atria and reduce heart rhythm disturbances.

item.title: Is Nof HaGalil changing? Joint List overtakes Likud to become city's largest party
item.description: Four years ago, Likud dominated the ballot boxes in Nof HaGalil. Now, the Joint List leads by thousands of votes.

item.title: The eight mistakes that brought Shas down
item.description: Journalist Michael Shemesh outlines eight mistakes behind Shas's 2026 election defeat, criticizing Aryeh Deri and his associates for losing touch with voters and reality.

item.title: The heartbreak behind the theft from the home of fallen Shin Bet officer
item.description: Police have located the ATV stolen from the family home of Yossi Tahar, a Shin Bet operative who fell on October 7, and arrested a suspect in connection with the theft.

item.title: 14 foreign citizens arrested on suspicion of entering a closed military area
item.description:
Police arrested 14 foreign citizens on suspicion of violating a legal order and staying in a closed military area near the Palestinian Authority village of Luban a-Sharqiya, south of Shechem.
The suspects were transferred to the Population Authority for a hearing, prior to their removal from Israel.

item.title: Trump: "We eliminated their nuclear weapons, we can take care of the remaining sites in ten minutes"
item.description:
United States President Donald Trump declared that Iran's nuclear program has been eliminated, but said there are still one or two sites that need to be addressed.
Trump added: "We can do it in ten minutes. Ten minutes. We have the plans for it."

item.title: Haredi extremists protesting against IDF recruitment
item.description: Dozens of haredi protesters attempt to block the road leading to the IDF Induction Center at Tel Hashomer in protest against the arrest of draft evaders.

item.title: 'I found a letter of rebuke from my brother Jabo-and I haven't stopped crying since'
item.description: On the anniversary of the death of Ze'ev (Jabo) Erlich, Rabbi Itzik Amitai reveals an unsent letter rebuking his eulogy for his rabbi as dishonoring their family and now asks for public forgiveness.
